DIAGNOSIS READY: Tuberculosis

I was surprised by that initial summary; given your history of recurrent urinary tract infections and current hematuria with flank pain, we cannot rule out a chronic infection. Please undergo a Urine Culture specifically for Mycobacterium tuberculosis and a CT scan of the kidneys, ureters, and bladder to visualize any parenchymal involvement.
